text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Whoa, my body's looking pretty toned...Hey, how'd you build that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー
引き締まってんな
私の体。
……あんたさ、
それどうやって作ったん？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hm? I didn't do anything special. Just played outside normally.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー？　
別になんにもしてないよ。
ふつうにお外で遊んでただけ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see—kids really move a lot, huh...*Munch munch* Ahh, chewing dried squid while lying down is the best thing in the world~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーんそっかあ、
子どもの運動量ってすごいんだな。
……むしゃむしゃ。
あー
寝転んだまましがむスルメが
この世で一番うまいわー

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, Sono-chan. I feel like the Iroha body you're using has gotten a bit weaker~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえねえソノちゃん。
ソノちゃんが使ってるイロハの体、
なんかパワーが落ちてる気がすんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I-I don't think so...?...Well, maybe I should build some stamina...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなことないと思うけどー？
……いやまあ
ちょっとは体力づくりするべきか……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Yay! Then let's go play outside!!We'll play pretend we can't go home until we catch 10,000 stag beetles!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！　
じゃあお外遊びに行こっ！！
クワガタ一万匹捕れるまで
帰れないごっこしよ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No way, you'd die before building up stamina.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
体力つく前に死ぬわ。
